description: Change a Dream Diary entry by dream_id: title, narrative, dreamed_at, mood, lucidity, people_names, places, tags or notes. Fields left out stay as they are; null clears mood, lucidity or notes. ($0.10; API key required)

lucidity.description: How lucid the dream was: none, partial or full, e.g. partial.

mood.description: Dream mood such as peaceful, happy, weird, scary or anxious, e.g. peaceful.

narrative.description: The dream in the user's own words, e.g. I was flying over the city at night.

notes.description: Free-text note, e.g. Follow up next week.

people_names.description: Names of people involved, e.g. ["Alex Chen"].

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

title.description: Short dream title, e.g. Flying over the city.
